scene.description: A cream cut-paper browser-window card lies flat on a warm grey paper surface. Its raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss with slotted address bar and three punched dots runs along the top edge. A clean rectangular window has been cut from its recessed content panel. A second sheet of navy paper is slotting into that opening from below, its near corner still lifted a few millimetres clear so the layer separation and paper thickness are visible. Warm light from beneath spills up through the cut opening and catches the lifted corner.
scene.one_idea: adding schema markup, shown literally as slotting a structured layer into a page
scene.note: this scene reproduces worked example B from brand-system.md section 7.9, the literal topic match

objects.state: lying flat, unmistakably a browser-window card: a raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss runs along the top edge holding a slotted address bar and three punched dots, and below it the recessed content panel has a clean rectangular window cut from it
objects.prop_definition: rounded rectangle of card stock, raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss with slotted address bar and punched dots, recessed content panel with a cut window
must_have: raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss along the top edge

objects.state: slotting into the cut opening from below, near corner lifted a few millimetres clear

lighting.key: soft warm key light, upper left, 3000K to 3500K, roughly 40 degrees, large diffuser, soft gradual shadow edges
lighting.fill: weak cool fill from the right, about one quarter key strength
lighting.practical: warm light from beneath the card spilling up through the cut opening, glowing at #FDE7C8, catching the lifted corner

camera.setup: B: straight-on macro, camera about 15 degrees above the card so the raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss, address-bar slot and dots are clearly visible, close enough that the paper fibre reads
camera.orientation: near-parallel to the card face, slight rotation so the layer separation is visible
camera.framing: approximately 30 to 40 degree field of view, close, layering and paper fibre legible

background.falloff: darker toward the top of the frame
background.note: everything outside the immediate card area reads neutral warm grey per worked example B

composition_rules.focal_position: off centre, roughly on a third
composition_rules.physical_plausibility: every object must be able to stand, lean or lie as shown
composition_rules.one_focal_group: exactly one warm-lit focal group with a single light source: the warm light spilling through the cut opening
composition_rules.navy_group_rule: the navy element is one object, or repetitions of one identical object in one contiguous composition; never mixed navy objects
composition_rules.navy_range: subdued navy paper only, #1A2340 to #3F4A68; no vivid, emitted or periwinkle blue

negative: Google or browser or search-engine marks
more than one warm light source
more than one navy element group
